result.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.11-slim

# System packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Python packages
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir torch==2.2.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir gymnasium==0.29.1 matplotlib==3.8.0 numpy==1.26.4 tqdm==4.66.0

WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . /workspace/

CMD ["python", "train.py"]

result.reproduction_definition: A faithful reproduction is achieved when the model is trained on the CartPole-v1 dataset using the specified hyperparameters (Adam optimizer, learning rate of 3e-4, batch size of 64, and 500,000 timesteps) in a Python 3.11 environment with PyTorch 2.2.0, and produces a mean episode reward of at least 475.0.
smoke_test_plan: Set up the Docker environment as specified in the environment spec.
Run a simple script to verify that the required packages (torch, gymnasium, matplotlib, numpy, tqdm) are installed correctly.
Execute a minimal training run for a few timesteps (e.g., 1000) to ensure that the training loop functions without errors.
full_run_plan: Clone the repository containing the training code.
Build the Docker image using the provided Dockerfile.
Run the training script (train.py) with the specified hyperparameters for 500,000 timesteps.
Monitor the training process to ensure it runs without interruptions or errors.
expected_outputs: A trained model file (e.g., model.pth) containing the weights of the trained model.
A log file (e.g., training.log) documenting the training process, including episode rewards.
A plot (e.g., rewards_plot.png) visualizing the mean episode rewards over time.
dataset_plan: Download the CartPole-v1 dataset using the Gymnasium library as specified.
Ensure the dataset is correctly loaded and accessible within the training script.
evaluation_plan: After training, evaluate the model on the CartPole-v1 environment.
Calculate the mean episode reward over a set number of episodes (e.g., 100 episodes).
Compare the mean episode reward to the target value of 475.0 to determine if the reproduction is successful.
verification_checklist: Verify that the Docker environment is set up correctly with the specified Python and package versions.
Confirm that the CartPole-v1 dataset is downloaded and accessible.
Check that the training script runs without errors and completes the specified number of timesteps.
Ensure that the mean episode reward meets or exceeds the target value of 475.0.
Review the output artifacts for completeness and correctness.
